scope: Reassess all previously processed Video-MME questions, across initial annotation/audit, evidence60, grouping60 and full-caption search; deduplicate by qid and preserve all source records. No new question sampling.
group_rule_zh: 以事件、动作、对象状态或语义阶段切分时间证据组。同一活动、同一场景、同一人物不强制合并。时间相隔较远的观察可分别成组，即使活动连续或内容相似；相邻片段若动作/语义阶段变化也可分组。不同组是否都为回答所需另行验证。
temporal_rule_zh: 输出各组起止时间及相邻间隔；不设未经校准的统一秒数阈值。不能用覆盖多个事件的大区间把跨片段题强行记成单组，也不能按相邻帧机械增加组数。
sufficiency_rule_zh: 保持原题和官方答案语义；允许替代路径、源中可恢复的关系。全集源支持、单组与删组检验继续保留；不以模型答对或答错定义证据充分性。取消跨独立活动/章节这一额外准入要求。
review_stages: Freeze all prior source records and exact hashes.
Review each substantive archived decision under the new rule; source-less technical failures remain unverified, never semantic rejection.
Re-use source checks only when the same question/facts/source intervals are unchanged; reopen boundaries, overlarge single groups and invalid subset conclusions for targeted source revalidation.
Report segmentation-policy review separately from original-source verification; never automatically promote a reopened question to confirmed.
